name: Azeroth Companion
title: WORLD ATLAS CARTOGRAPHER’S LENS — Premium Regions, Intel & Performance
approval_note: Owner approved Atlas presentation, usefulness, detail and performance improvements; physical iPhone and live-game testing remain pending.
features: World Atlas now features eight new original compact region panoramas, a cinematic region selector and a more immersive research-first visual interface.
New detailed field guide for all 25 curated destinations, including non-fabricated research prompts and read-only counters from saved manual missions, bookmarks, v17 sessions and v18.1 routes.
Instant destination finder can jump to the right region and focus a selected map pin; dedicated handoff returns you to the safe original mission form.
Focus Pins toggle reduces icon crowding and preserves accessibility, automatically using compact mode for iPhone-sized displays.
Improved render responsiveness through batched frame updates, reusing local data indexes, deferring regional illustration and offscreen route panel rendering.
Verified external real-game map research links to Warcraft Wiki Maps and Wowhead Maps. Original NEXUS illustrations remain separate from official WoW coordinates.
Everything from v18.1 stays available, including maps, saved routes, goals, music, Forge, Battle.net connection and protected user data; no new stored key or account changes.
